zh.title: 波音777-9與737 MAX 10邁向認證最後階段 預計2027年投入營運
zh.summary: 波音777-9與737 MAX 10接近完成認證，預定2027年投入營運。
body: 根據 Simple Flying 報導，波音公司（Boeing）旗下 777-9 與 737 MAX 10 兩款客機正接近完成認證程序的最後階段。這兩款主要機型目前均按計畫推進，預計將於 2027 年正式投入商業服務。
在 777X 計畫方面，該項目先前已獲得美國聯邦航空管理局（FAA）核准，依據 4B 號類型檢驗授權（TIA 4B）展開認證飛行測試。波音公司持續預估該機型首架飛機將於 2027 年完成交付。
針對 737 系列衍生型 737-10，波音亦持續推進相關認證測試。相關公開資訊顯示，波音公司預計該機型於 2026 年取得認證，並於 2027 年向客戶交付首架飛機。

en.title: Boeing 777-9 and 737 MAX 10 Near Final Certification Ahead of 2027 Entry Into Service
en.summary: Boeing 777-9 and 737 MAX 10 aircraft enter final certification stages before planned 2027 service entry.
body: According to Simple Flying, Boeing's 777-9 and 737 MAX 10 aircraft programs are approaching the final stages of their certification process. Both airplane models are scheduled to enter commercial service in 2027 as the manufacturer completes remaining regulatory requirements.

For the 777X program, Boeing previously received approval from the U.S. Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) to initiate certification flight testing under Type Inspection Authorization 4B (TIA 4B). The manufacturer continues to project first delivery of the aircraft in 2027.

Regarding the narrowbody variant, Boeing has also been advancing certification flight testing for the 737-10. Public records indicate that Boeing anticipates achieving certification in 2026, with initial customer delivery scheduled for 2027.

zh.title: 聯合航空規劃自西岸樞紐營運11條夏季直飛亞洲航線
zh.summary: 聯合航空規劃夏季自美西樞紐營運11條直飛亞洲航線；搭配僅限冬季服務。
body: 根據相關服務規劃，聯合航空預計於下個夏季航季期間，從該公司位於美西的航網樞紐營運11條直飛亞洲的定期航線。這項排程規劃將提供美西樞紐連接亞洲地區的直飛班機服務。
除了下個夏季所要執行的11條亞洲直飛航線外，聯合航空亦將配置僅限冬季營運的季節性航線班次。這代表該航空公司在規劃夏季航線網絡的同時，亦搭配冬季限定的季節服務。
這項航線佈局顯示聯合航空對亞洲市場的運能安排，涵蓋了下個夏季從美西樞紐出發的11條直航路線，以及在冬期間運作的季節性航班服務。

en.title: United Airlines Plans 11 Nonstop Summer Asia Routes From West Coast Hub
en.summary: United Airlines plans 11 nonstop summer Asia routes from its West Coast hub alongside winter seasonal flights.
body: United Airlines is planning to operate 11 nonstop summer routes to Asia from its primary West Coast hub. Under the announced schedule, the carrier will provide direct flights connecting its West Coast operational base with key destinations in Asia during the upcoming summer travel season.

Alongside the 11 nonstop Asia routes scheduled for next summer, the carrier will also run a winter-only seasonal service. The planned network strategy incorporates both the expanded summer transpacific flight schedule and dedicated seasonal flights reserved specifically for the winter period.

The transpacific route lineup establishes United Airlines' scheduled flight offerings between the U.S. West Coast and Asian markets across both next summer's core schedule and the winter seasonal operations.

zh.title: 孟加拉據報擬購20至24架中國J-10CE戰機
zh.summary: 孟加拉據報接近訂購20至24架中國J-10CE戰機；Eurofighter採購仍未定。
body: 據《Aerospace Global News》報導，孟加拉據報接近訂購約20至24架中國成飛J-10CE（ICAO機型代碼J-10CE）戰鬥機。
報導引述孟加拉《每日星報》消息，指孟加拉總理顧問Zahed Ur Rahman表示「若本財政年度有預算支援，採購將繼續；否則將延至下一個預算」。
報導提到，孟加拉是否繼續Eurofighter採購仍未明朗，並分析J-10CE具單引擎、成本較低的優勢，且可沿用既有中國製戰機操作經驗。
亦有報導指出，J-10C飛離成本約6250萬美元，但加計附加項目與援助後可能升至1.15億美元。
目前孟加拉與中國均未確認需求為20或24架戰機，採購案仍屬計畫階段。

en.title: Bangladesh reportedly close to ordering 20-24 Chinese J-10CE fighter jets
en.summary: Bangladesh reportedly close to ordering 20-24 Chinese J-10CE fighters; Eurofighter purchase still uncertain.
body: Bangladesh is reportedly close to ordering around 20-24 Chinese Chengdu J-10CE fighter jets, according to Aerospace Global News.

Citing a report by Bangladesh's The Daily Star, Prime Minister's Adviser Zahed Ur Rahman was quoted as saying that if budget support is available this fiscal year, the purchase will go ahead; otherwise, it will be deferred to the next budget.

It remains unclear whether Dhaka will also proceed with a Eurofighter purchase. The J-10CE is considered cheaper (perhaps half the cost) than the Eurofighter, and would build on Bangladesh's existing Chinese-made fighter fleet.
Neither Dhaka nor Beijing has confirmed whether the current requirement is for 20 or 24 fighters.
